title: santia unioloides
intro: Santia unioloides, commonly known as the Yellow Myrtle, is a plant species belonging to the Santalaceae family, characterized by its yellow flowers and woody stems. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Santia unioloides include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to act as an immunomodulator, which may help regulate the immune system. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
